settings.richtext: Click it onto the hose, soak the surface, walk away. The weather does the slow work — moss, mould and lichen fade over the following weeks and stay gone for ages.

settings.heading: How it compares
settings.content: Bleach-based cleaners work fast — then you rinse the result (and the bleach) down the garden. Spray-on concentrates need mixing and a pump sprayer. Soak n Go clicks onto the hose, needs no mixing, no scrubbing and no rinsing, and the result keeps improving for weeks.

settings.heading: Safety & the garden
settings.content: No acid, no bleach, no chlorine. It's still a serious outdoor cleaner though, so treat it like one: water surrounding plants and grass before and after you apply, keep spray off plants and animals, and keep everyone off surfaces until they're dry. Don't apply if rain's expected within 12 hours. Full safety directions are on the label.

settings.heading: Delivery & guarantee
settings.content: NZ-wide delivery in 2–4 working days, free over $79. If it doesn't work, we'll make it right — we wash buildings for a living, so we know what clean looks like.
